thread:
marta (docs): Heads-up: Publishing a breaking docs change for the batch inference examples. The payload key `batch` is being replaced with `requests` to standardize with the rest of our APIs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1623

owen (sdk): Impact summary: this affects SDK convenience helpers that accepted `batch: [{input, meta}]`. We'll ship a minor SDK release with a shim that accepts both `batch` and `requests` for two releases. Recommend migration before the hard cutoff.

jas (eng-runtime): Runtime behavior: we'll accept both keys for 45 days; after that the server will return 400 with a clear error message. We'll also emit `Deprecation-Warning` headers during the grace window.

lee (product): Timeline: docs preview + SDK shim release next Tue, canary flip Wed, full flip 2 weeks after canary. Deprecation window 45 days after flip. We need customer comms for Dedicated customers.

pat (support): Noted. I'll prepare KB with example diffs and a troubleshooting checklist for 400s. Also will compile a list of top accounts that use batch endpoints.

owen (sdk): Example old vs new for copy/paste:
```js
// OLD
await client.batch({ batch: [{ input: "A" }, { input: "B" }] })
// NEW
await client.batch({ requests: [{ input: "A" }, { input: "B" }] })
```

marta (docs): I'll add a migration doc under "Recipes -> Batch" with JS/Python/Go snippets and a tiny CLI replacer script. Also adding a banner and changelog entry.

jas (eng-runtime): CI plan: add an E2E that posts both `batch` and `requests` forms to ensure the shim behaves, and a nightly job that flips to only `requests` to validate we catch regressions before cutoff.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1623 (:rocket:)

deploy-bot: Canary flip scheduled: 2026-07-08 15:00 UTC (window 30m)

lee (product): Action list: 1) @marta migration guide + banner 2) @owen SDK shim + release 3) @jas runtime header + CI checks 4) @pat KB + top-account outreach 5) @support/product draft customer email. Please ack and post PR links here.

owen (sdk): Ack 5

pat (support): Ack, start drafting KB now.

marta (docs): Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and ping me for blockers. :sparkles:
